title: A persona's recent work keeps it consistent
description:
The voice_examples layer, for a Story with a persona, prefers that persona's own recent published Stories, newest first and within the existing budget, then the section's. Needs a query by persona (an index on the persona id of published Stories), never a scan.
Scenario: persona A's draft pack shows A's last published Stories before other examples. Scenario: a new persona with no published work falls back to the section's examples as today's layer does.
